name: ai-meeting-notes
description: Extracts summaries, action items with owners and deadlines from messy meeting notes or transcripts.

profession.en: Meeting Notes & Action Items Extraction Expert

displayDescription.en: Paste messy meeting notes, transcripts, or email threads to auto-extract a summary, action items with owners and deadlines, and key decisions, then saves searchable files and syncs a to-do list.
displayDescription.zh: 粘贴会议笔记或转写文本，自动提炼摘要、负责人、截止日期与行动项，归档可检索并联动待办清单跟踪执行。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Extract action items and owners from these meeting notes
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 从这段会议笔记中提取行动项和负责人

quickPrompts.en: Extract action items and owners from these meeting notes
quickPrompts.zh: 从这段会议笔记中提取行动项和负责人

quickPrompts.en: Summarize this meeting and save it to the archive
quickPrompts.zh: 总结这次会议并保存到归档

quickPrompts.en: Show all my to-do items and overdue tasks
quickPrompts.zh: 查看我所有的待办事项与逾期任务
